native_lattice.method: Direct native-image faint cross centres, grayscale perpendicular line response within 12px of approximate lattice seeds. Outer map background only, radius >962px from(955,960); 1/3 stratified holdouts; affine fit.

method_details.response: minimum of perpendicular filtered line responses
method_details.contrast_threshold_note: Exploratory low-contrast candidates produced JPEG-noise false picks. Final1.5threshold chosen after visual review; no high-quality point excluded by model residual.
method_details.split: holdout if (c+2*r)%3==0; all other accepted points fit
method_details.fit: ordinary least-squares affine using19fit crossings;10outer and10interior checks not used in fit
method_details.visual_review: Each accepted native outer and interior crop inspected; centre is unoccluded grid cross.

native_interior_checks.selection: Ten visibly legible plus-shaped crossings selected from34interior diagnostic crops after inspection; no interior point was used to fit native affine. These are alignment checks, not a preregistered sampling experiment.

source26_native_architecture_fit.method: SIFT on quarter-resolution source26 and native image; manually masked faint cross neighborhoods, cursor, prominent labels/icons. Lowe ratio0.74; RANSAC2.5native-pixel threshold,20000max iterations/confidence0.999;12inlier features (11unique positions). No cross used in fit.

source25_to_source26_architecture_fit.method: SIFT on half-resolution photographs; overlap masks remove cross neighborhoods/cursor/prominent labels; Lowe0.65, RANSAC4source26-pixel threshold,20000max iterations/confidence0.999.114inlier features(102unique positions); no cross used in fit.

runtime_configuration.label: Atlas cross grid

index_convention.origin: The model-defined northwest reference crossing is node A1=(0,0). Columns increase east A-R; rows increase south1-18.
index_convention.cell_label: The northwest crossing names its cell; A1 spans grid[0,1)×[0,1).
index_convention.boundary_assignment: Half-open cells: a point exactly on a grid line belongs to the cell east/south of that line.
index_convention.distinct_from_prior_research_origin: This global native-image A1 is not the Wild Zone20-local A1 used in the earlier research packet.

domain.measured_bounds_note: Bounds enclose sampled nodes, not every node. A1 itself was too faint to measure. Native error statistics apply only to measured nodes; the conventional grid extends beyond the measured bottom row.
domain.edge_policy: Clip each cell polygon to native image bounds. Row18 and columnR are partial edge cells. The narrow top/left strips before A1 have no labelled cell. Do not assign points outside image bounds or negative grid indices.

distance_scale.sixty_observation: Owner video displays waypoint60 at21s; exact endpoints, footsteps, metres, feet and universal60-per-interval conversion are not established.

evidence.interpretation: Pixel residuals measure alignment of observed crosses on these images. They are not certified item-location accuracy or ground-distance uncertainty.

limitations: Atlas-created labels and origin; no official developer coordinate system or construction purpose claimed.
The native lattice is approximated by one affine model; direct held-out visible crossings support sub-two-pixel native alignment in measured areas.
Displayed fractional-cell precision is representational precision, not measured ground accuracy.
Photograph transforms are valid only in their measured control hulls; central-photo extrapolation reaches9native pixels and must not promote new exact pins.
The native lattice does not locate unverified items or structures; each marker retains its existing source/floor/confidence evidence.

edge_diagnostics.northwest_A1: Not accepted as a direct measurement; faint intersection is obscured by JPEG artefacts. Origin comes from the fitted lattice.
edge_diagnostics.outcome: No clear cross centres accepted; local contrast enhancement mostly exposes JPEG quantization blocks. No bottom-edge measured error bound claimed.
